name: Orik Goldvein
source_profile: ● Orik Goldvein (NE) is a prosperous claim broker who purchases disputed dwarven deeds from impoverished families and resells the associated mineral rights to Cadorian investors. Although technically a member of the Claimholders, his business dealings have earned him considerable resentment among his own people.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 76 (source excerpt; may be partial)
